d: Violent protests have erupted across Bangladesh after the banned Awami League party carried out nationwide demonstrations. The protests come after former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina was denied a new passport by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's government. Hasina, who has been living in India under exile has announced her return to Bangladesh in December 2026. However, she does not have a valid passport, which was revoked after the fled Bangladesh in August 2024 due to massive student protests.
